title: Monotonicity of visited cells
statement: Let $M$ be a deterministic multi-tape Turing machine with Boolean work-tape symbols and state set $S$, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, and let $c$ be a configuration on $x$. If $t\leq t'$, then for every work-tape index $i$, the set of cells visited by tape $i$ from $c$ through step $t$ is contained in the set visited through step $t'$.
hypotheses_covered: A deterministic multi-tape Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols and state set $S$
